items.title: Serving GLM-5.2-MXFP4 on AMD Instinct™ MI355X: When Prefill Context Parallelism Pays
items.summary: Whether prefill context parallelism pays depends on prompt length. It divides the prompt across GPUs during prefill; on four AMD Instinct™ MI355X GPUs (gfx950) serving GLM-5.2-MXFP4 under SGLang at --tp-size 4, enabling it yields 43% to 54% more total throughput on 40,960- and 61,440-token prompts at concurrency 16 and above, and a first token about 1.5× to 2.3× faster at every concurrency. On 1024-token prompts it loses at every concurrency measured, by 8% to 18% of total throughput.
